victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victims is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victims is described.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Land dispute and brotherhood are with the informant, not the deceased; the friend link is to the son, not the accused.

offence_category.reason: The case was charged and tried as murder under s.302 with attempt under s.307, so Murder is supportable.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charged sections and final conviction under s.304 Part I and s.307 are all stated in the judgment.

weapon.quote: the 12 bore DBBL gun loaded with two live cartridges used for the offence
weapon.reason: Gun is correct, but 'double-barrelled' is an expansion of DBBL not stated in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery, site plan and cartridge shells are all relied on in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court notes firing at persons within sight, causing death and injuries, which fits the noted facts.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: the appellant was overpowered by an uncontrollable fit of anger
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Anger, root cause, sequence of events and the twelve-year lapse are all noted as mitigating.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicting the appellant for the offence under Sections 302 and 307 IPC while acquitting the co-accused
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sentences, fines, concurrency and co-accused acquittal all match the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court has concurred with the sentence as well.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal and affirmed conviction and sentence, per the judgment.

offence_finally_established.quote: The conviction of the appellant is converted to one under Section 304 Part I and 307 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Final convictions under s.304 Part I and s.307 are stated in the operative order.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term years are stated in the final order.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary with gendered pronouns for the accused removed (e.g., 'The accused came with the accused's own son' rephrased neutrally) and 'double-barrelled' removed

offence_severity.quote: sentence of life imprisonment and fine of Rs.5,000/-

attempt_completion.reason: The murder/death and firing with injuries show a completed offence.

physical_harm.quote: which hit Paramjit and Jatinder on their abdomen and Lakhwinder on his mouth and head
physical_harm.reason: Death of Jatinder and injuries to the informant, Paramjit and Lakhwinder match the judgment.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.quote: the appellant was overpowered by an uncontrollable fit of anger
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no intention to eliminate, and the act was on impulse; no premeditation found.

motive.reason: Land dispute is marked as alleged, and the abuse as trigger, matching the judgment's narration.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness, recovery, cartridge shells, site plan and medical evidence are all relied on by the Court.

witness_credibility.quote: The eye-witnesses including the informant have offered a consistent, coherent and convincing narration
witness_credibility.reason: Court found eyewitnesses trustworthy and rejected the family relationship plea.

post_offence_conduct.quote: the appellant and the accused fled the scene

trial_duration.reason: Offence date 06.07.2002, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Appellant and State counsel names and roles match the judgment's appearance block.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge-sheet and completed trial are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and partial Supreme Court allowance all match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.quote: the charge levelled against the appellant stands proved beyond reasonable doubt and thus the concurrent determinations of the courts below do not warrant any interference

defence_argument.quote: the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the charge against the appellant

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied the intention versus knowledge distinction leading to s.304 Part I, and the co-accused acquittal point.

sentencing_rationale.quote: it would meet the ends of justice, if the sentence for the offences is reduced to the period already undergone
